Outstanding Banh Mi
Aug 2024 • Couples
Easy to miss this place as it’s up a narrow set of stairs on P. Hang Voi in the old quarter not far from the lake. Look for their sign and take the stairs between the two business at street level, it’s worth the effort. Brilliant Banh Mi and a good variety of options. Ice cold beer. Sit for a while and watch life go buy in the street below
